card.title: Delete my account
card.body: Your account is hidden and you are signed out everywhere. Your in-game name, email, UID and WhatsApp number become free for a new account.

dialog.reasonPlaceholder: Helps us fix what pushed you out.
blockers.account_suspended: Your account is suspended. Contact support.
blockers.account_banned: Your account is banned. It cannot be deleted while the ban runs.
blockers.account_is_staff: You hold a staff role. Ask a head admin to remove it first.
blockers.owns_team: You own a team. Transfer ownership or disband it first.
blockers.owns_organization: You own an organization. Hand it to another member first.
blockers.owns_sponsor: You own a sponsor account. Hand it to another member first.
blockers.owns_shop: You have a shop. Ask support to close it first.
errors.confirm_mismatch: Type your in-game name exactly as it appears.
